1.web: “‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no regular work: it is a day of blowing of trumpets to you.
1.asv: And in the seventh month, on the first day of the month, ye shall have a holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work: it is a day of blowing of trumpets unto you.

2.web: You shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;
2.asv: And ye shall offer a burnt-offering for a sweet savor unto Jehovah: one young bullock, one ram, seven he-lambs a year old without blemish;

3.web: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenth parts for the bull, two tenth parts for the ram,
3.asv: and their meal-offering, fine flour mingled with oil, three tenth parts for the bullock, two tenth parts for the ram,

4.web: and one tenth part for every lamb of the seven lambs;
4.asv: and one tenth part for every lamb of the seven lambs;

5.web: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you;
5.asv: and one he-goat for a sin-offering, to make atonement for you;

6.web: besides the burnt offering of the new moon, and its meal offering, and the continual burnt offering and its meal offering, and their drink offerings, according to their ordinance, for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
6.asv: besides the burnt-offering of the new moon, and the meal-offering thereof, and the continual burnt-offering and the meal-offering thereof, and their drink-offerings, according unto their ordinance, for a sweet savor, an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.

7.web: “‘On the tenth day of this seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall afflict your souls. You shall do no kind of work;
7.asv: And on the tenth day of this seventh month ye shall have a holy convocation; and ye shall afflict your souls: ye shall do no manner of work;

8.web: but you shall offer a burnt offering to Yahweh for a pleasant aroma: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old; all without defect;
8.asv: but ye shall offer a burnt-offering unto Jehovah for a sweet savor: one young bullock, one ram, seven he-lambs a year old; they shall be unto you without blemish;

9.web: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenth parts for the bull, two tenth parts for the one ram,
9.asv: and their meal-offering, fine flour mingled with oil, three tenth parts for the bullock, two tenth parts for the one ram,

10.web: a tenth part for every lamb of the seven lambs:
10.asv: a tenth part for every lamb of the seven lambs:

11.web: one male goat for a sin offering; besides the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and their drink offerings.
11.asv: one he-goat for a sin-offering; besides the sin-offering of atonement, and the continual burnt-offering, and the meal-offering thereof, and their drink-offerings.

12.web: “‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work. You shall keep a feast to Yahweh seven days.
12.asv: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month ye shall have a holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work, and ye shall keep a feast unto Jehovah seven days:

13.web: You shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: thirteen young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old; all without defect;
13.asv: and ye shall offer a burnt-offering, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah; thirteen young bullocks, two rams, fourteen he-lambs a year old; they shall be without blemish;

14.web: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenth parts for every bull of the thirteen bulls, two tenth parts for each ram of the two rams,
14.asv: and their meal-offering, fine flour mingled with oil, three tenth parts for every bullock of the thirteen bullocks, two tenth parts for each ram of the two rams,

15.web: and a tenth part for every lamb of the fourteen lambs;
15.asv: and a tenth part for every lamb of the fourteen lambs;

16.web: and one male goat for a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.
16.asv: and one he-goat for a sin-offering; besides the continual burnt-offering, the meal-offering thereof, and the drink-offering thereof.

17.web: “‘On the second day you shall offer twelve young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
17.asv: And on the second dayye shall offertwelve young bullocks, two rams, fourteen he-lambs a year old without blemish;

18.web: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
18.asv: and their meal-offering and their drink-offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

19.web: and one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, with its meal offering and their drink offerings.
19.asv: and one he-goat for a sin-offering; besides the continual burnt-offering, and the meal-offering thereof, and their drink-offerings.

20.web: “‘On the third day eleven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
20.asv: And on the third day eleven bullocks, two rams, fourteen he-lambs a year old without blemish;

21.web: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
21.asv: and their meal-offering and their drink-offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

22.web: and one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.
22.asv: and one he-goat for a sin-offering; besides the continual burnt-offering, and the meal-offering thereof, and the drink-offering thereof.

23.web: “‘On the fourth day ten bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
23.asv: And on the fourth day ten bullocks, two rams, fourteen he-lambs a year old without blemish;

24.web: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
24.asv: their meal-offering and their drink-offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

25.web: and one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.
25.asv: and one he-goat for a sin-offering; besides the continual burnt-offering, the meal-offering thereof, and the drink-offering thereof.

26.web: “‘On the fifth day nine bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
26.asv: And on the fifth day nine bullocks, two rams, fourteen he-lambs a year old without blemish;

27.web: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
27.asv: and their meal-offering and their drink-offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

28.web: and one male goat for a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.
28.asv: and one he-goat for a sin-offering; besides the continual burnt-offering, and the meal-offering thereof, and the drink-offering thereof.

29.web: “‘On the sixth day eight bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
29.asv: And on the sixth day eight bullocks, two rams, fourteen he-lambs a year old without blemish;

30.web: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
30.asv: and their meal-offering and their drink-offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

31.web: and one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and the drink offerings of it.
31.asv: and one he-goat for a sin-offering; besides the continual burnt-offering, the meal-offering thereof, and the drink-offerings thereof.

32.web: “‘On the seventh day seven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
32.asv: And on the seventh day seven bullocks, two rams, fourteen he-lambs a year old without blemish;

33.web: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
33.asv: and their meal-offering and their drink-offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

34.web: and one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.
34.asv: and one he-goat for a sin-offering; besides the continual burnt-offering, the meal-offering thereof, and the drink-offering thereof.

35.web: “‘On the eighth day you shall have a solemn assembly: you shall do no regular work;
35.asv: On the eighth day ye shall have a solemn assembly: ye shall do no servile work;

36.web: but you shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: one bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;
36.asv: but ye shall offer a burnt-offering, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah: one bullock, one ram, seven he-lambs a year old without blemish;

37.web: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the ordinance:
37.asv: their meal-offering and their drink-offerings for the bullock, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the ordinance:

38.web: and one male goat for a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, with its meal offering, and its drink offering.
38.asv: and one he-goat for a sin-offering; besides the continual burnt-offering, and the meal-offering thereof, and the drink-offering thereof.

39.web: “‘You shall offer these to Yahweh in your set feasts, besides your vows, and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings, and for your meal offerings, and for your drink offerings, and for your peace offerings.’”
39.asv: These ye shall offer unto Jehovah in your set feasts, besides your vows, and your freewill-offerings, for your burnt-offerings, and for your meal-offerings, and for your drink-offerings, and for your peace-offerings.

40.web: Moses told the children of Israel according to all that Yahweh commanded Moses.
40.asv: And Moses told the children of Israel according to all that Jehovah commanded Moses.
